mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 7% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decreases for 2 months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS decreases for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and real final sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 5% YoY, it signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST YoY > 10% and RSAFS YoY > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% YoY, it signals a supply-side recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 0 for 2 quarters and INDPRO YoY < -1%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 < 0 for 2 quarters and INDPRO YoY < -1%.
